declare @c char(1), @d char(1), @q nvarchar(4000), @key varchar(256), @ngay_tu varchar(32), @ngay_den varchar(32) select @c = char(253), @d = char(252) select * into #t from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@@queryString, @c) select @ngay_tu = data from #t where id = 2 select @ngay_den = data from #t where id = 3
select @key = ' and cast(a.ngay_giao_dich as date) between ''' + @ngay_tu+''' and ''' + @ngay_den +''''
exec zrs_getDMGDData @key, '@@fieldExternal'
